run_cat_files: run cat_files.py to concatenate two or more text files into a single output file
run_cat_files_multiple: run cat_files.py with multiple input files and an output flag to merge them into one file
review_main: review the main function that parses arguments and concatenates files with newline separation
review_print_and_exit: review the print_and_exit helper that writes an error message to stderr and exits with code 1
refactor_cat_files: refactor cat_files.py to support streaming large files instead of loading all content into memory
